title: Write cold outreach email
content:
Write a cold outreach email to {{name}} at {{company}}.
The purpose is: {{goal}}.

Rules:
- Under 5 sentences
- No buzzwords
- Value must be clear in the first line
- End with a specific, low-commitment CTA
ai_prompt: Write a cold outreach email to {{name}} at {{company}}. The purpose is: {{goal}}. Rules: under 5 sentences, no buzzwords, make the value clear in the first line, end with a specific low-commitment call to action.
